name: Emirates student fares
summary: Discounted Emirates flights from Australia plus extra baggage for full-time students aged 16 to 31 using code STUDENT.
key: Save up to 10% on Economy Class flights and up to 5% on Premium Economy and Business Class flights.
who: Full-time students aged between 16 and 31 years old at the time of the outbound travel date.
how: Book with the promo code STUDENT.
Bring your student ID or school acceptance letter to check-in.
catches: Extra 10kg or 1 extra piece of baggage.
Without valid student ID at the airport, the student ticket benefits are forfeited.
